{{Quote|When I was nearly captured in the Lorn system some time ago, it was the Sandwind operatives who helped me find the Vuzsa safehouse and hole up until Moff Murquan gave up on me&hellip;|Tiree, personal addendum to Rebel Task Force on Alliance Security SecuriDex file on the "Jundland Banshee"|<ref name="AIR" />}}
'''Vuzsa''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. It served as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along the [[Trans Gulf Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a [[Vuzsa safehouse|safehouse]] at Vuzsa, at which the Rebel agent [[Tay Vanis|Tiree]] once hid in order to evade capture by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
Vuzsa was a nondescript [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Vuzsa system/Legends|Vuzsa system]], a part of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated in the nearly [[Star/Legends|starless]] void known as the [[Gulf of Tatooine/Legends|Gulf of Tatooine]] and was located on the [[Trans Gulf Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii]] and [[Piroket system/Legends|Piroket systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:TireeVanis.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Rebel agent Tiree once hid out at a Vuzsa safehouse.]]
Vuzsa served as a [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] point for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] making the long run along the Trans Gulf Route.<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a [[Vuzsa safehouse|safehouse]] at Vuzsa.<ref name="AIR" />

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Murquan]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] nearly captured the Rebel agent [[Tay Vanis|Tiree]] in the<ref name="AIR" /> [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Lorn system/Legends|Lorn system]]. At that point, the Alliance's [[Sandwind group]], based out of the Arkanis sector planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], helped Tiree locate the Vuzsa safehouse, allowing him to wait out until the Imperials stopped looking for him. Tiree eventually relayed the incident in a personal addendum to the Rebel [[Task Force on Alliance Security]]'s [[SecuriDex]] [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] on the rogue [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] known as the "[[Jundland Banshee]]."<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vuzsa was introduced via mention of the Vuzsa safehouse in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AIR" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' established Vuzsa as a distinct world and placed it in grid square R-16.<ref name="TEA" />
